description: Read one Coverage Cat docs resource by URI from the default consumer MCP and return its URI, public href (null when it has no public page), MIME type, and full markdown, JSON, or YAML text.

uri.description: A coveragecat:// or ui:// resource URI from docs_list_topics or docs_search.

name: docs_get_resource

href.description: Public web URL for the same content, or null when the resource has no public page.

mime_type.description: Format of text, such as `text/markdown`, `application/json`, or `text/yaml`.

text.description: The full resource body in mime_type format.

uri.description: The resource URI that was read.

title: Coverage Cat docs resource reader
